name: solo-agent-guards
description: Guards for running a coding agent alone: prove the test catches the bug, prove the push landed, prove each status claim, and check the finish line before saying done.

plugins.name: solo-agent-guards
plugins.description: test-and-prove breaks the guard to show a test catches it. change-integrity checks that only your changes went up and actually landed. claim-audit checks that each status claim rests on the evidence its verb needs. done-checklist writes the finish line first, turns corrections into a checklist, and runs both before reporting done.
